attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Marriage and Family Therapy (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.alternatives: No CE hours required for renewal; licensees must still complete implicit bias training (1 hour per year of the cycle) and a one-time human trafficking training.

topics.who: 1 hour per year of the 3-year license cycle (3 per cycle); may count toward general CE since March 23, 2023
One-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking meeting Mich. Admin. Code R 338.7202

rules.notes: Michigan's marriage and family therapy law does not require continuing education for renewal (LARA guide rev. 1/26/2026). License valid 3 years.
